elements.char: Among the most complex of animal behaviors are collective behaviors, in which animals
elements.label: text

elements.char: interact with each other so as to produce large-scale organization. Starved first-stage larvae
elements.label: text

elements.char: exhibit such a behavior: they come together to
elements.label: text

elements.char: form aggregates of several hundred worms. How and why they do this are unknown. To
elements.label: text

elements.char: address these questions, we developed a mathematical model of starved L1 aggregation.
elements.label: text

elements.char: This model reproduced the main features of the behavior.
